summary.headline: Backend-focused Full-Stack Developer specializing in Python, FastAPI, and AWS
summary.description: Backend-focused full-stack developer with 9 years of experience building production systems end-to-end, from architecture through deployment. Strong specialization in Python, FastAPI, SQL, asynchronous APIs, cloud infrastructure, and CI/CD, complemented by solid React and TypeScript experience. Finance and investment-domain background, including an MSc in Banking and Finance and CFA Level I, with growing specialization in AI engineering, agentic workflows, and RAG.
